_meta.purpose: Appendix F — grammar completion and the decoding declaration. Appendix E found a three-level grammar tower (G1 material/cell, G2 regulatory/tissue, G3 architecture/organ) read by one level-and-shape operator. This appendix completes the GRAMMAR map in three directions and issues an honest decoding declaration. (1) ORGAN ATLAS: G2 is generalized horizontally — the same regulatory operator reads cardiac, neural, AND hepatic identity from real promoters (a 3x3 organ x grammar confusion matrix), not heart alone. (2) DYNAMICAL grammar G4 (pragmatic level): one locus yields a FAMILY of readings by cell state, indexed by a CpG-island methylation-sensitivity signal that is orthogonal to the material and read by the SAME operator -> (gamma_4, A4_4). (3) BODY-PLAN grammar G5 (genre level): Hox colinearity — linear genomic order equals anterior-posterior body order — read by the same operator -> (gamma_5, A4_5). The DECLARATION is two-axis: STRUCTURAL decoding is complete (every grammatical level is identified, formalized, sequence-readable, orthogonal, one operator); FUNCTIONAL decoding is NOT (named [O] obstacles: enhancer-activity validation, absolute methylation state, the real 3D body map). 100% means the grammar is fully mapped — what remains is measurement, not undiscovered grammar.

the_completed_grammar_space.interpretation_axis: G1 material -> G2 regulatory -> G4 dynamical (cell/tissue/state)
the_completed_grammar_space.organization_axis: G3 architecture -> G5 body-plan (organ layout -> body genre)
the_completed_grammar_space.breadth: the organ ATLAS: G2 read across cardiac, neural, hepatic (not heart alone)
the_completed_grammar_space.one_operator: robust_z (median-centred, MAD-scaled) at G1, G2, G4, G5 -- identical

_meta.rule: LOCK -> Derive -> Gate. No fitted parameters. precision (jeongmil) != accuracy (jeonghwak). 반증 = 발견. Add-only: Appendix E's G1/G2/G3 and every prior number, grade, equation, and DOI are unchanged; G4/G5 are NEW rungs and the atlas is G2 generalized. The structural declaration is earned by the gate; the functional obstacles are named, and functional completion is held False.

grades.[L]: locked: real genomic sequence / assembly coordinates / cited TF motifs / cited colinearity
grades.[V]: verified: exact decomposition or logical invariant (precision)
grades.[F]: fixed modelling choice (consensus motifs, windows, seed, thresholds); declared
grades.[O]: open: functional / quantitative validation absent; named obstacle

organ_grammars._axis: Three ORGAN cis-regulatory grammars (G2 generalized horizontally). Each is a consensus IUPAC motif set for the organ's core transcription-factor code. The cardiac set is identical to Appendix E's (add-only). Motifs are scanned on both strands; organ identity is read by shuffle-NORMALIZED enrichment-z against a dinucleotide background, which removes the GC/degeneracy confound of raw counts.

cardiac.provenance: Core cardiac GRN consensus motifs (identical to Appendix E): GATA4, NKX2-5 (NKE), MEF2C, TBX5, bHLH/HAND E-box. JASPAR + cardiac-GRN literature (Olson 2006; Bruneau 2013).

neural.provenance: Core neural GRN consensus motifs: SOX (HMG box), BRN2/POU3F2 (POU octamer), REST/NRSF (RE1/NRSE), NEUROD1 (E-box), OLIG2 (E-box). Neural GRN literature (Schoenherr & Anderson 1995 REST; Bertrand 2002 proneural bHLH; Wapinski 2013 neural-conversion TF code).

hepatic.provenance: Core hepatic GRN consensus motifs: HNF4A (DR1 half-site), HNF1A, FOXA/HNF3, CEBPA, DBP (D-box). Liver GRN literature (Odom 2004 HNF circuitry; Kyrmizi 2006 hepatic TF network; Schrem 2002 liver-enriched factors).

atlas_promoters._axis: Nine REAL human proximal promoters (GRCh38, 900 bp, gene-sense), spanning three organ classes plus a housekeeping control: cardiac (NPPA, TNNT2 — re-locked from Appendix E), neural (PAX6, NEUROD1, SYN1), hepatic (ALB, APOA1, TTR), and the GAPDH housekeeping control (re-locked from Appendix E). Unmodified assembly sequence; the organ-atlas confusion matrix is read from these.

NPPA_cardiac.provenance: Human NPPA proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000001.11 11847783-11848682 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand). NPPA is a canonical cardiac-restricted gene whose promoter carries GATA and NKE (NKX2-5) cardiac elements.

TNNT2_cardiac.provenance: Human TNNT2 proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000001.11 201377680-201378579 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS). TNNT2 is a cardiac-muscle-restricted gene with characterized cardiac regulatory elements.

PAX6_neural.provenance: Human PAX6 proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000011.10 31817962-31818861 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand), fetched from NCBI E-utilities for offline reproduction.

NEUROD1_neural.provenance: Human NEUROD1 proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000002.12 181680518-181681417 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand), fetched from NCBI E-utilities for offline reproduction.

SYN1_neural.provenance: Human SYN1 proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000023.11 47619858-47620757 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand), fetched from NCBI E-utilities for offline reproduction.

ALB_hepatic.provenance: Human ALB proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000004.12 73403387-73404286 (plus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand), fetched from NCBI E-utilities for offline reproduction.

APOA1_hepatic.provenance: Human APOA1 proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000011.10 116837623-116838522 (minus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand), fetched from NCBI E-utilities for offline reproduction.

TTR_hepatic.provenance: Human TTR proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000018.10 31590977-31591876 (plus) (900 bp upstream of TSS, gene-sense strand), fetched from NCBI E-utilities for offline reproduction.

GAPDH_housekeeping.provenance: Human GAPDH proximal promoter, GRCh38 NC_000012.12 6533617-6534516 (plus) (900 bp upstream of TSS). GAPDH is a ubiquitously-expressed housekeeping gene with a CpG-island promoter and NO cardiac-specific regulatory program -- the negative control for the cardiac grammar.

hox_colinearity._axis: The canonical sequence-encoded BODY-PLAN map (G5, genre level): Hox colinearity — the linear genomic order of the HOXD cluster equals the anterior-posterior body order. Genomic TSS coordinates are NCBI assembly facts (GRCh38, NC_000002.12); the AP body rank (anterior=1 at the 3' end HOXD1, posterior=9 at the 5' end HOXD13) is the colinearity fact established by Lewis 1978 and Duboule & Dolle 1989. The body rank is the only non-coordinate input and is graded [L] from that literature.
hox_colinearity.provenance: HOXD cluster, GRCh38 NC_000002.12, nine TSS coordinates fetched from NCBI. Spatial (AP) colinearity: Lewis 1978 (Nature 276:565); Duboule & Dolle 1989 (EMBO J 8:1497).

nn_stacking_dG_kcal_per_mol._axis: G1 MATERIAL -- SantaLucia 1998 unified nearest-neighbour Delta-G(37C) parameters (kcal/mol), the cell-level material the corpus already uses. The signal s1[i] = dG(S[i:i+2]) along the sequence; gamma_1 = mean(s1), A4_1 = robust_z(s1).
nn_stacking_dG_kcal_per_mol.provenance: SantaLucia J Jr 1998, PNAS 95:1460-1465, 'A unified view of polymer, dumbbell, and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics'. Unified NN Delta-G_37 set; the same pipeline the corpus uses for measured gamma.

settings._axis: Declared modelling choices for the atlas, dynamical, and body-plan readings.

shuffle_seed.note: dinucleotide-shuffle base seed; identical to Appendix E (add-only continuity).

atlas_nshuf.note: number of dinucleotide shuffles per (promoter, grammar) for the enrichment-z background; declared, not tuned to a target.

cpg_window_bp.note: half-width of the sliding window for the CpG O/E methylation-sensitivity profile (the G4 dynamical signal); standard CpG-island window scale.

control_quiet_z_max.note: gate ceiling: the GAPDH housekeeping control's strongest organ-grammar enrichment-z must fall below this (a properly tissue-neutral control).

g4_orthogonality_corr_max.note: gate ceiling: mean |corr(CpG O/E, material dG)| across loci must be below this for G4 to be orthogonal to the material level.

g5_colinearity_corr_min.note: gate floor: |corr(genomic order, AP body rank)| across the HOXD cluster must be at least this for colinearity.

declaration_axis._axis: The two-axis completion distinction that lets the decoding declaration be honest. STRUCTURAL/grammatical decoding asks: is every grammatical LEVEL of the blueprint identified, formalized, sequence-readable, orthogonal, and read by the IDENTICAL operator? FUNCTIONAL/quantitative decoding asks: does each level's reading predict the measured phenotype (enhancer activity, absolute methylation, the real 3D body map)? The first can be complete while the second is not — 'the grammar is fully mapped; what remains is measurement, not undiscovered grammar.'
declaration_axis.structural_axis: identification + formalization + sequence-readability + orthogonality + one-operator, across all grammatical levels
declaration_axis.functional_axis: quantitative prediction of measured phenotype at each level — held-out functional datasets

appendix_e_link._axis: Appendix E established the three-level tower and left three [O] channels. This appendix builds horizontally (organ atlas) and upward (G4 dynamical, G5 body-plan), and converts the question 'is the grammar complete?' into the honest two-axis declaration.

appendix_e_found_three_levels.provenance: Appendix E (grammar-hierarchy interpreter): G1 material -> (gamma_1, A4_1); G2 regulatory -> (gamma_2, A4_2); G3 architecture -> (gamma_3, A4_3); completion.complete=False with three [O].

_open.functional_enhancer_activity: structural: each organ grammar reads identity from sequence. functional: that A4 predicts measured enhancer ACTIVITY per organ (VISTA/ATAC/H3K27ac/MPRA) with a pre-registered rank test is [O].
_open.absolute_methylation_state: structural: the CpG-island signal indexes the state FAMILY (G4). functional: the ABSOLUTE methylation beta-values per cell state (WGBS) are [O].
_open.real_3d_body_map: structural: Hox colinearity gives the body-plan ORDER (G5). functional: the real 3D body map (Hi-C/Micro-C across the embryo; the colinear spatial-domain TF map staged across development) is [O].
